Title: Public Preview: MSSQL Extension Integrates GitHub Copilot in VS Code

Body.Content:
The MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code now works with GitHub Copilot, bringing AI-powered SQL assistance directly into your development workflow. This integration enables you to work with your database schema using GitHub Copilot. With just a few clicks in Visual Studio code, you can generate T-SQL and ORM code, explore schemas, and, even if you’re new to SQL, build, analyze, and optimize queries—all with help from GitHub Copilot. 

 

Whether you’re building modern web apps, cloud-native solutions, or AI-driven experiences, GitHub Copilot helps you understand the business logic embedded in your database, follow best practices for security and performance, and even generate mock data for rapid testing. GitHub Copilot and the MSSQL extension work together to help reduce repetitive work, accelerate your development, and provide intelligent guidance as you design and build applications faster.  

Learn more.
